scenario_results.note: single-flight: two concurrent executions of the same binding perform ONE provider fetch + ONE canonical commit — the loser waits on the per-transaction file lock (close_gap_locks/<txn>.lock, acquisition-mutex pattern) and completes as reused with fetch=0
bounded retry: retryable staging failures (AdapterProcessError.retryable) retried up to 3 attempts with exponential backoff; non-retryable fails immediately (1 attempt)
idempotent recovery: a re-run after a successful close reuses — one document, no extra locations (writer content-hash dedupe pinned)
the single-flight lock wait is bounded by the coordinator timeout + grace; lock exhaustion is a failed (retryable) result, never a hang
M1 single-flight lock removed -> CG-C1 fails (2 fetches); M2 retry disabled -> CG-C2 fails
